q: (the passage of time that overtakes everything material)
Verily man is at a loss
...except those who have Imaan, who do good deeds, who encourage
the truth and who encourage each other to exercise Sabr.
(This Surah is so comprehensive that the renowned scholar Imaam Shaafi'ee (R.A) stated that if nothing but this Surah was revealed, it would have been sufficient for the guidance of man.)
v.s: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
v.c: except those who have faith, do good, and urge each other to the truth, and urge each other to perseverance.
